decisions.reason: A multi-model garage door operator line is a core accessory that drives garage door sales, so it will likely be updated rather than withdrawn, though its absence from the 2020–2021 website adds some uncertainty.

The single remote-controlled operator still complements garage door sales, but it is the most likely candidate to be folded into the broader operator line, especially as it no longer appears on the website.
Glazed industrial sectional doors are a standard part of a full industrial portfolio, but overlap with the similar Product F makes consolidation plausible.
The insulated glazed door meets rising energy-efficiency requirements for commercial buildings and fits the firm's thermal solutions focus.
This glazed industrial door was the featured model with its own page, so it is likely the one retained if the glazed range is consolidated.
